title: Mud Pit Zip
lines: Liz has a jet, and Zac has a bus.
Liz lets the jet hop from a log.
Zip! It got in the mud pit.
Zac lets the bus hop from the log.
Zip! It got in the mud pit.
Mud is on the jet. Mud is on the bus.
"We had a mud win," said Liz.
Liz rubs the jet, and Zac mops. It is fun to run a jet.
